01 · Foundation work

Systems that route, decide and deliver.

Projects from university, training and independent practice, built around orchestration, communication and useful outcomes.

01 / Flagship

Hermes multi-agent orchestrator

A WhatsApp-connected orchestrator built during AI Automation training at Bitlogia Institute of Technology. One lead agent routes requests to seven specialists. The right agent can publish an article to WordPress, answer store-order questions or prepare a social post. Publishing actions remain behind an approval step.

WhatsAppWordPressFacebook7 agentsHuman approval
02 / n8n · 19 nodes

HR recruitment system

A 19-node n8n recruitment workflow. Applications enter through Google Sheets and Claude scores each CV out of 100. Shortlisted candidates receive an interview invitation and reminder; the final route sends either an offer letter with its Google Drive contract or a rejection email.

n8nGoogle SheetsClaudeGoogle DriveCandidate email
03 / Make.com

Institute inquiry pipeline

A Make.com scenario where AI classifies each incoming institute query as urgent, medium or low priority. The route then sends either a session-confirmation email or a cold email.

Make.comAI triageEmail automation

Scholarship file manager

OpenClaw integrated with my computer and given a practical brief: organize scholarship-application data. It turned the material into a clean folder structure, making the application work easier to navigate.

03 · About

Curious mind · careful builder

I am Noor Fatima, an automation engineer interning at Bitlogia Institute of Technology.

I completed BIT's AI Automation & Agentic AI program from 13 June to 22 September 2026. My work spans multi-agent orchestration, n8n and Make.com workflows, data collection, reporting automation and quality assurance.

I am now building toward an MSc in HCI / Human-Centred AI and applying for the Commonwealth Master's Scholarship 2027.

Working principleKeep humans in the loop—with approval gates for consequential actions and no unverified reporting.
